hook.name: AnyPositionManager (Flaunch vested launch hook)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for fair-launch memecoin pools. Implements an internal swap pool that fills swaps against fee inventory before they reach the AMM, a BidWall for liquidity support, creator fee distribution with optional referrer payouts via hookData, and temporal launch gating (pools revert until a configurable flaunchesAt timestamp passes).
